4667.title: [skia-sync] Update release/4.151.x with Chrome M151 fixes
4667.author: mattleibow
4667.body:
[skia-sync] Update release/4.151.x with Chrome M151 fixes (#4667)

Changes: https://github.com/google/skia/compare/c3226a9bcd777ce15adb61e7181aac2aa57cf6da...86bb2f25f46f4d620b4a26e738f59a9b6c22d2eb
Companion: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/342

Advance externals/skia from 4998e69e2e to the merged release-line
commit bdd0c3a8ea. This incorporates seven upstream M151 fixes covering
Ganesh flush failures and stale readbacks, the Imagination FBO driver
workaround, Fontations bitmap-strike selection, and SkSL map-pointer
handling.

Keep all M151 servicing, soname, and package versions unchanged. No C
API or generated binding changes are required.

Update cgmanifest with the chrome/m151 provenance and source-backed
dependency evidence for 15 legacy registrations without changing their
semantic versions.

The Linux x64 native source build and full unfiltered test suite pass.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
